M5a baseline — BEFORE apply

WHAT EXISTS
  ops_timeline(date,date)   absent
  _ops_as_date(text)        absent
  is_staff()   (from M5)    PRESENT
  organizations.is_test     PRESENT, Test Co flagged

THE PREDICTION (written before applying)
  Two functions appear and NOTHING else changes. M5a creates no table, adds no
  column and writes no row -- it is a read.

  _ops_as_date must NOT be callable by anon or authenticated. ops_timeline
  MUST be callable by authenticated. The migration refuses to finish if either
  is wrong, so a bad grant cannot ship quietly.

  Asked for the fortnight around today, ops_timeline should return BOPEU and
  Sedimosa and NOT Test Co -- the test organisation is excluded inside the
  function, not on the page, so no caller can forget to filter.

  Every row it returns should be service_line 'financial'. There is no
  counselling work in the system yet, and M3 is what changes that.

  IF IT IS WRONG: nothing existing can be damaged, because nothing existing is
  written to. The worst case is the Tuesday screen showing the wrong week.
  Undo with migrations/rollback-m5a-ops-timeline.sql.
